source_metadata Build the source metadata block that every parser attaches to its dvobject.

Source: R/source_metadata.R
source_metadata.Rd

Unknown fields stay NA; nothing is guessed. retrieved_at is never taken from file modification dates. File hashes are SHA-256 and need R >= 4.5.0 (tools::sha256sum()); on older R they are NA.

Usage

source_metadata(
  source,
  source_name = source,
  files = character(),
  release = NA,
  release_date = NA,
  retrieved_at = NA,
  source_url = NA,
  licence = NA,
  licence_url = NA,
  attribution = NA
)

Arguments

source

short source id, e.g. "hgnc"

source_name

full source name

files

paths of the input files that were parsed

release

source release label as published, e.g. "5.1"

release_date

source release date (Date or "YYYY-MM-DD")

retrieved_at

date the files were downloaded (Date or "YYYY-MM-DD")

source_url

source download or home page

licence

SPDX licence id, e.g. "CC0-1.0"

licence_url

licence or terms page

attribution

credit or citation sentence the source asks for

Value

list, the metadata block
